thread:
josh_product: Quick heads-up — putting the 'Shuttleboard' initiative on the roadmap tentatively for Q3. Need a short cross-team check: three scope questions to resolve before we lock the launch window.

maria_pm: thanks josh. what are the three items?

josh_product: 1) per-tenant quantization profile support (opt-in); 2) predictable prewarm/burst for dedicated pools; 3) HSM/KMS flow for private pilot.

alex_runtime: brief notes from runtime: per-tenant quantization is doable but we need model variant pinning + CI for numeric parity checks. extra testing adds ~2 weeks.

kevin_infra: prewarm/burst: infra can provide burst nodes but autoscaler hooks need a small API change (new lease API) and a canary policy. estimate 3w to ship + 1w for load test.

tara_security: HSM/KMS: we can support HSM for private if we get final threat model and key rotation SLA. also need access requirements for on-prem install. unclear if the pilot customer accepts HSM later in rollout.

maria_pm: ok — sounds like timeline risk from infra and runtime. tara, how strict is the threat model? can we do a minimal gating checklist for pilot?

tara_security: yes — minimal checklist: 1) documented key lifecycle, 2) attestation plan, 3) RBAC for key ops. if those exist we can greenlight pilot without full HSM integration.

alex_runtime: for quant pinning, proposal: expose `model_variant` on serve config and run numeric regression job: `python infra/tests/regression.py --baseline v1 --candidate v1-q8` in CI. if regression <0.5% failure we allow opt-in.

josh_product: good — can we map owners and deadlines? goal: decide by EOD next Tue so PMs can commit to roadmap.

kevin_infra: owner: kevin_infra + infra-ops. target PR for lease API by Fri (3 days), internal test by next Thu.

alex_runtime: owner: alex_runtime + runtime-team. CI job at branch level by Mon next week, regression infra ready by Wed.

tara_security: owner: tara_security. minimal checklist doc in Confluence by Mon.

maria_pm: I'll collect acceptance criteria and customer alignment. I'll ask pilot customer about HSM flexibility today.

devops-bot: NOTE: Scheduled load test window available Wed 02:00-06:00 UTC — reserve if needed.

josh_product: Thanks all. next steps: owners push PRs/docs into the shared `shuttleboard/q3` folder and ping this thread. if any timeline slips, call it out asap — we have a dependency matrix to update. :thumbsup: 

alex_runtime: pinged. I'll drop a short checklist in the folder and link the CI job.

kevin_infra: reserving Wed window. will put an initial API draft in the folder by EOD Fri.

maria_pm: adding the customer reply here once I hear back.

(emoji reactions: :eyes: from tara_security, :rocket: from josh_product)
